newsitem.title: USA: Dixie to buy Shelter carpet unit.
newsitem.headline: Dixie to buy Shelter carpet unit.

text.p: Dixie Yarns Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a letter of intent to buy Danube Carpet Mills Inc, a subsidiary of Shelter Components Corp, for $25 million in cash.
The transaction is expected to close on or about December 31. Its completion is subject to the companies reaching a definitive agreement and securing regulatory approvals.
Dixie said additionally that it would "continue to seek desirable acquisitions."
Danube makes and sells carpeting for manufactured homes and recreational vehicles. Dixie, a textile and floor covering company, estimated the unit's sales at $75 million.

Shelter, a distributor of materials used in the construction of manufactured homes and recreational vehicles, said in a separate statment that it was still assessing how it would use proceeds from the Danube sale.
